source_notes: West German Bundeswehr 1955-1990, unified Bundeswehr after. Epochs per docs/05: E1 1950-59, E2 1960-69, E3 1970-79, E4 1980-89, E5 1990-2004, E6 2005-15, E7 2016+. Entry epoch = entered_service year; carried-over entries repeat the in-service variant with basis noting inheritance. Gun gens per docs/11 (G3 = 120mm L/44, G4 = L/55, G5 = L/55A1); radar gens R1-R5 per docs/11. Faction identity per docs/08: best armor (Leopard line), best fuel economy (diesel powerpacks), strong SHORAD (Gepard/Roland), NO organic AEW at any epoch, non-nuclear navy, Type 212A AIP submarines as the naval special. All numbers recalled without web access; every uncertain field is listed in estimated_fields. Speeds in km/h (ship knots converted), ranges in km; aircraft road_range_km = typical combat/ferry range as noted in basis.
